scope: exploratory follow-up on reused evaluation years; no independent confirmation
selection: best baseline and model on development balanced accuracy before evaluation
size_rule: last observed count bins 1-2,3-5,6-10,11+; no future inputs
size_balanced_rule: training within-bin class frequencies divided by global training class frequencies; fallback global if bin n<30
gate: gain >=0.03 versus selected baseline and positive in both evaluation years
